disclaimer: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Synthetic stewardship logic for a prototype; not clinical guidance.

vanc_allergy_severity.description: Highest recorded severity of any vancomycin allergy/intolerance in the allergies table; 'none' if no row.

mrsa_isolated.description: MRSA isolated from any specimen collected in the 14 days up to requested_at.

mrsa_vanc_susceptible.description: The MRSA isolate(s) in the window test vancomycin-susceptible (S). Null if no MRSA or vancomycin not tested.

septic_shock.description: Current episode: sepsis with vasopressor requirement to maintain MAP >= 65 despite fluid resuscitation.

hemodynamic_instability.description: Currently hypotensive (SBP < 90 or MAP < 65, incl. intradialytic hypotension forcing HD to stop early) or on vasopressors at time of request.

prior_mdro_colonization.description: Documented history, before this episode, of colonization or infection with MRSA, VRE, ESBL or CRE.

outcomes.APPROVE_ELIGIBLE: Criteria for restricted vancomycin met (MRSA susceptible isolate, or empiric use in shock / unstable MDRO-colonized patient). Reassess at 48-72h with cultures.
outcomes.DENY_ELIGIBLE: Criteria not met (severe vancomycin allergy, or stable patient without MRSA/MDRO risk). Suggest alternative; routes to pharmacist, never auto-denied.
outcomes.PHARMACIST_REVIEW: Ambiguous or high-risk situation (non-susceptible MRSA, unstable without MDRO history, stable with MDRO history). Pharmacist/ID judgement needed.
outcomes.NEED_INFO: A variable needed on the decision path could not be determined from the record.
